identity.lineage: The owner's one reservation about In Step was the length of its main early shift: 06:20-15:15 (8h 55m) and 07:00-15:45 (8h 45m), four a weekday, 40 a year each, where today none is over 8h 30m. Every 26-line design averages 8h 16m a duty (44,100 minutes over the 89 duties the 219-day ceiling allows; today's link 8h 14m), so the length can only move: today it sits on the closers (8h 40m on a weekday, 9h 10m on a Saturday), In Step put it on the earlies so its lates could be 8h 00m. Even Step puts it back where today has it on the lates, at 8h 30m, and keeps In Step's 8h 10m closers. Searched with every duty capped at 8h 30m and every closer starting at 15:45 or later (owner: "1545 is the minimum"), and laid on In Step's own weeks, it keeps every rule, no fatigue factor, the days in a row, the weekends, the rest, the leave and the late finishes, with 18 weeks on one shift time; it costs a weekday fit of 32.6 against 29.8 and a Saturday fit of 10.0 against 9.6, a week-to-week change of 1h 31m against 1h 13m, a heaviest week of 41h 30m against 41h 05m, and the floor lates' half hour.
